items.title: Roy Carew Interview, 1958-Fall
items.q: I put that on paper and sent it the same to us. John Stark sent it back.

ctx.x: I think it's often just about the business that he did at Tony Jackson's that he heard Tony do in New Orleans, and then Tony did again in Chicago when he saw him there.

That part comes into a piece I call Recreation Rag. I wrote number two also. I used a little of what I thought was a honky-tonk string in that two bars that turns out to be part of Tiger Rag. Let's see if I can do it without stumbling. . . They whistled that all around town down there. And I don't know if they whistled any more than that, but that got stuck in my head. What was the name of that one? Well, I put it, as I say, into a rag and call it a recreation rag. But this little bar... When did you write that?…
That's, yeah, that's what it was that he was doing.
